title: CVE-2023-33558 (ocomon)
summary: An information disclosure vulnerability in the component users-grid-data.php of Ocomon before v4.0.1 allows attackers to obtain sensitive information such as e-mails and usernames.

Description
An information disclosure vulnerability in the component users-grid-data.php of Ocomon before v4.0.1 allows attackers to obtain sensitive information such as e-mails and usernames.
